```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\CanUserInterface;
use Illuminate\Auth\Guarded Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Interfaceable;
use Illuminate\Auth\Reminders\Remindable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as AuthenticatablePolicy;

class CategoryPolicy extends AuthenticatablePolicy
{
    use HandlesAuthorization;

    public function viewAny(User $user, Category $category)
    {
        return $user->can('view', $category);
    }

    public function view(User $user, Category $category)
    {
        return $user->can('view', $category);
    }

    public function create(User $user, Category $category)
    {
        return $user->can('create');
    }

    public function update(User $user, Category $category)
    {
        return $user->can('update');
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Category $category)
    {
        return $user->can('delete');
    }
}
```
